sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS e, AVG((CAST("player"."Tries" AS REAL) / "player"."Apps")) AS m1 FROM "player" GROUP BY "player"."Club_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: tries scored / appearances: a ratio of two quantities in count
average of tries scored relative to appearances per club (by Club_ID)
gap to the all average of average of tries scored relative to appearances (all level)
gap to the all average of average of tries scored relative to appearances (all level)

why: total of points scored per club (by Club_ID) (additive)
share of the all total of total of points scored (all level)
gap to the all average of total of points scored: share of the all total (all level)
